about.lead: I'm Rifaldi, a web developer who <mark>builds websites professionally as a full-time job</mark>, and takes on freelance landing pages for founders and small businesses.
about.body: My approach is simple: take your brief, turn it into a fast, clean page, and get it live in days, not weeks. You get one person from first message to launch, so nothing gets lost between a designer, a developer, and a project manager.
